episodes.title: Broken Fall
episodes.summary: After a teen girl with a strange wound is found in Amon County, Ohio, she is taken to the hospital in a nearby town and put in Dr. Suzanne Mathis' care.

episodes.title: Sanctuary
episodes.summary: Mae adjusts to life with the Mathis family while Suzanne tries to find her a foster home. Detective Alex Lopez makes an unsettling discovery.

episodes.title: Mother's Keeper
episodes.summary: After enrolling in Jules' school, Mae attracts attention from the newspaper editor. Suzanne reaches out to Mae's parents. Peter asks a friend for help.

episodes.title: Rely-Upon
episodes.summary: Alex digs for answers about Amontown and Suzanne consults an expert. Jules' photo of Mae causes a stir at school, with unexpected consequences.

episodes.title: Alight
episodes.summary: Suzanne gains more clarity on what Mae experienced at Amontown. Halloween night doesn't go as planned for Jules, who begins to question Mae's motives.

episodes.title: My Love and I
episodes.summary: Alex makes a key connection after the fire. Painful memories surface for Suzanne. A fearful Mae tries to stop Jules from going on a date.

episodes.title: By Blood
episodes.summary: The night of the Harvest Dance brings a full moon and chaos as Suzanne desperately tries to keep Mae safe. Alex realizes the cult's powerful influence.

episodes.title: The Dawning
episodes.summary: Suzanne follows Mae to the Amontown compound, where the Dodd family and their followers prepare for a deadly ritual. The Mathises seek a fresh start.
